input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $17.50 deduction on order DD-51115, dated 2026-11-04, which was applied with the reason "missing item" (Jhol Momo). The order ticket for DD-51115 lists 'Jhol Momo', which shows the order was prepared as placed [DD-51115:ticket_lists_item]. Our records show the order was ready at 12:55 and picked up at 12:58, three minutes later [DD-51115:pickup_handoff]. We recognise these records do not show the contents of the bag at handoff, and we are describing only what they show. Given the ticket and the pickup timing, we respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
